settings.title: Business profile
settings.subtitle: Who you invoice as: your details, branding, bank account, numbering and defaults.
settings.forbidden: You do not have permission to see the business profile.
settings.readOnly: You can view the business profile but not change it. Ask a workspace admin for the invoice settings permission.
settings.notSavedYet: Nothing has been saved yet. The fields show the defaults new invoices would use.
settings.issues: {count, plural, one {# field needs attention} other {# fields need attention}}

conflict.message: Someone else changed the business profile while you were editing. Reload to see their version; your edits will be replaced.

leave.title: Leave without saving?
leave.message: You have unsaved changes on this page. If you leave now they are lost.

suggest.title: Use the usual settings for {country}?
suggest.body: Set the default tax regime to "{regime}" ({taxLabel}) and the fiscal year start to {month}. You can still change both below.

v.country: Use a two-letter country code such as IN or GB.
v.state: Use a code of 1 to 3 letters or digits.
v.hex: Use a hex colour such as #0B3D2E.
v.dueDays: Enter a whole number from 0 to 365, or leave empty for due on issue.
v.rowIncomplete: Fill in both the label and the value, or remove the row.

format.year: A series that restarts every year needs '{YEAR}' or '{YY}' in the format, or its numbers would repeat.

business.title: Business
business.description: Printed as the seller on every invoice, credit note and proposal.
business.name: Legal or seller name
business.nameHint: The name your customers should pay and file under.
business.registrationHint: Company or business registration number, if you have one.
business.addressHint: One line per row, as it should print.
business.countryHint: Decides the tax id format, the number rules and the tax rates offered.
business.stateHintList: For tax purposes, the state the business is registered in.
business.stateHintFree: A code of 1 to 3 letters or digits (optional).
business.emailHint: Shown on invoices so customers know where to ask questions.
business.extraHint: Anything the law asks you to print, for example CIN or LUT number. Up to {max} rows.

taxId.label: Tax ID ({label})
taxId.noCountry: Choose the country first so the right format can be checked.
taxId.noSpec: {country} has no tax id format to check. The value is saved as you type it.

requirement.required: Required on invoices in this country.

taxId.validChecksum: This {label} is well formed and its check digits are correct.
taxId.validFormat: This {label} has the right format. No check digits are published for it, so only the shape is checked.
taxId.invalidChecksum: This {label} has the right shape but its check digits do not match.
taxId.canStillSave: You can still save it: the checker may be out of date, or the number may be a special case.
taxId.mismatch: This id belongs to {state} ({code}), which is not the state chosen above. Tax on your invoices depends on the state, so check both.
taxId.formatNote: This checks the format only, not whether the number is registered. Verify registration with the tax authority.

branding.title: Branding
branding.description: How your invoices look to customers.
branding.logoHint: A public https address of your logo image.
branding.logoUploads: Uploading a logo file belongs to the files area; here you paste the address of a hosted image.
branding.logoBroken: The image could not be loaded from this address.
branding.colorHint: A hex colour used for accents on printed invoices.
branding.invoiceTitleHint: The heading printed on invoices, for example Tax Invoice. Leave empty for the standard heading.
branding.footerHint: A line at the bottom of every invoice, such as thanks or a legal note.

payment.title: Payment details
payment.description: Where customers should send money. Shown on invoices and on the public invoice page.
payment.bankHint: Label and value rows, up to {max}: IBAN, account number, UPI id and so on.
payment.instructionsHint: Extra words for the payer, such as which reference to quote.
payment.previewHint: A simplified preview. The real invoice has your logo, lines and totals as well.

numbering.title: Numbering
numbering.description: Each document type has its own series, so invoice numbers stay in sequence.
numbering.prefixesHint: 1 to 10 letters or digits per document type.
numbering.formatHint: Built from '{PREFIX}', '{YEAR}', '{YY}' and '{SEQ}'; it must contain '{SEQ}'.
numbering.fiscalMonthHint: '{YEAR}' is the year the fiscal year started in.
numbering.yearlyHint: Counts from 1 again when a new year (or fiscal year) begins. The format must then show the year.
numbering.examplesHint: The first number of each series for today's date, with the current settings.
numbering.limitsTitle: These numbers may not meet the rules in {country}
numbering.warnChars: {doc}: contains characters that are not allowed.

defaults.title: Defaults
defaults.description: What new invoices start with. Each invoice can still change them.
defaults.currencyHint: A workspace setting: it is changed in the workspace settings, not here.
defaults.dueDaysHint: Days after the issue date the invoice is due, from 0 to 365.
defaults.dueOnIssue: Empty means the invoice is due on its issue date.
defaults.remindersHint: Remind customers automatically when an invoice passes its due date.
defaults.regimeHint: The country rules new invoices are priced under. None means no automatic tax.
defaults.loadRates: Load tax rates for my country
defaults.loadRatesNeedsCountry: Choose your country above to load its tax rates.
defaults.notesLanguage: These notes come from the tax engine and are in English.
defaults.disclaimer: Tax rates and rules are defaults to check with your accountant or tax authority. They change, and they are not tax advice.

online.title: Online payments
online.description: Connect a payment provider so customers can pay from the public invoice page and paid invoices update by themselves.
online.noPermission: You need the invoice settings permission to see or change the online payment connection.
online.whenOn: Customers can pay online and your provider reports payments to the webhook below.
online.whenOff: Without a connection the public invoice page shows your bank transfer details instead.
online.modeHint: Use test mode until your provider's test payments arrive correctly.
online.providerHint: More providers will be added later.
online.webhookHint: Give your provider this path on your API host. It is not a secret; the signature is.
online.webhookNone: The address appears after the first save.
online.secretStored: A secret is stored and never shown again. Enter a new one only to replace it.
online.secretNone: At least 16 characters. It is stored encrypted and never shown again.
online.secretOnce: Copy the secret now and give it to your provider: it cannot be shown again after saving.
online.needsSecret: Add a signing secret before turning online payments on.
online.liveWarning: Live mode: real customer payments will be recorded.
online.bankFallback: Online payments are off, so customers see your bank transfer details from the payment section.
